slates.label: Thursday picks
slates.note: Hit-rate slate: seven low rungs on starters who cleared them in every or nearly every game this season, plus JAX ML against a rookie QB in Thursday-night rain. Joint hit chances are 69%, 72% and 62%. Nothing new to grade yet (Week 9 starts tonight); I applied last week's lessons: Pinnacle baseline, no unders, no weather-exposed passing legs.

parlays.why: Jacksonville faces undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano (Lamar on IR, Huntley out for the year) in a thunderstorm that favors the better run game; JAX ML is fair 82% (Pinnacle de-vigged 82%) vs book 83% at -500. BAL safety Malaki Starks plays every snap (Hawkins out) and has 4+ tackles in 7 of 8 games (10 last week); rain means more runs and more tackles, so 4+ is fair 83% vs book 83.5%. Mild positive same-game link; joint 69%.

Bucky Irving has 45+ rush yds in all 8 games (15-27 carries) and gets a dry, 49F Chicago night; 40+ is fair 84% (ladder fit to Pinnacle and DK mains, 82%) vs book 85%. Washington K Drew Stevens has 4+ kicking points in all 7 games (13/15 FG) under sunny 61F skies in Landover; 4+ is fair 85% vs book 83%. Independent games; joint 72%.

Drake Maye has 178+ pass yds in all 8 starts, and DK moved his 170+ rung from -483 to -660 today, so the market agrees; fair 86% vs book 87% in dry 56F Foxborough against a Packers defense without Parsons. Rome Odunze has 39+ rec yds in all 8 games on a 90%+ snap share; 20+ is fair 86% vs book 86%. Kyren Williams has 41+ rush yds in 8 of 8 as the lead back (16 carries a week) for a Rams team favored by 4.5; 30+ is fair 84% vs book 84%. Three games and three positions; joint 62%.

slates.label: Tuesday picks
slates.note: Week 9 Tuesday: three short, high-hit-rate parlays (69%, 69%, 55% joint) of low alt rungs and JAX ML in place of last week's long shots, which went 1-12. No defensive or kicker markets are posted yet, so this slate has none.

parlays.why: Bryce Young has thrown 30+ passes in 6 of 7 games (avg 38.4) and Carolina is a home underdog with a depleted secondary and a fired DC, so a pass-heavy script is likely; DK's ladder puts 30+ at fair 84% vs book 82% (-470). Jacksonville faces undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano (Lamar on IR, Huntley out) after the line moved from BAL -4.5 to JAX -9.5; ML fair 82% vs book 82% (-470). Independent games, joint 69% (payout 1.47x, EV +0.02).

Burrow is healthy and has 220+ in 5 of 7 (avg 302) for a CIN offense implied for ~28 points in the Madrid dome-type venue (roof retractable; light rain forecast, 3 mph wind); 220+ is fair 82% vs book 81% (-440). Higgins has 4+ catches in 5 of 7 with 11 targets last week; 4+ is fair 81% vs book 81% (-419). Same-game positive correlation (game sim: Burrow loads 0.31 on CIN points, Higgins catches 0.24 on QB yards; latent rho ~0.27) lifts the joint to 69% (payout 1.42x, EV -0.02) vs 67% independent.

Three steady volume legs in three different games, no weather risk (Charlotte 61F calm, Chicago 51F light wind, Foxborough 48F ~11 mph). Hubbard has 40+ rush yds in 6 of 7 (22 carries last week) as Carolina's lead back: fair 85% vs book 86% (-595). Caleb Williams has 200+ in 4 of 5 healthy starts (avg 253) at home: fair 79% vs book 81% (-420). Maye has 180+ in 7 of 8 (missed once by 2 yds): fair 80% vs book 80% (-411). Joint 54% (payout 1.80x, EV -0.03).

slates.label: Saturday picks
slates.note: Week 8 Saturday slate: 9 team legs, 4 defensive and 2 kicker legs. The edges lean on team-total unders (storms in Tampa and Miami, depleted NE/DEN offenses), the model's Minnesota lean, a stale MIA +2.5 rung, and tackle/sack/FG overs.

parlays.why: Five independent views plus one same-game pair. MIN +1.5 and DET team total U20.5 are a correlated pair: the power ratings make Minnesota the better team (model DET -1.0 vs market -3). Szmyt is the kicker for a field-goal-heavy Cleveland offense in a 38.5 total. Daniel Jones projects as a 10-point dog behind a line that lost Nelson. New England is without A.J. Brown and Henderson and plays in storms. Edges: Detroit Lions team_totals Under 20.5 (+180) fair 40% vs book 36%; Minnesota Vikings spreads +1.5 (+118) fair 48% vs book 46%; Andre Szmyt field_goals Over 1.5 (+104) fair 54% vs book 49%; Daniel Jones pass_attempts Over 33.5 (+139) fair 49% vs book 42%; New England Patriots team_totals Under 21.5 (+175) fair 40% vs book 36%. Joint hit 3.4%, app payout 68.16x, EV +1.30 (still +0.83 after a 2-pt haircut on every leg).

Lamar's return and a Buffalo secondary missing CJGJ and maybe Alford should hold Buffalo under 25.5. Chuck Clark has gone over 5.5 tackles in 4 of 6 games (7.0 per game). Elijah Higgins' longest catch averages about 19 yards in the model. Edges: Buffalo Bills team_totals Under 25.5 (+165) fair 39% vs book 38%; Chuck Clark tackles_assists Over 5.5 (+117) fair 48% vs book 46%; Elijah Higgins reception_longest Over 14.5 (+170) fair 44% vs book 37%. Joint hit 8.4%, app payout 15.53x, EV +0.31 (still +0.14 after a 2-pt haircut on every leg).

Atlanta plays in Tampa thunderstorms without Brian Robinson. JSN averages 124 yards and could gain targets if Shaheed (DNP Friday) sits. Cole Bishop starts beside Hamlin with Gardner-Johnson suspended, facing the Lamar/Henry run game. Edges: Atlanta Falcons team_totals Under 20.5 (-104) fair 54% vs book 51%; Jaxon Smith-Njigba reception_yds Over 109.5 (+126) fair 48% vs book 44%; Cole Bishop tackles_assists Over 7.5 (+179) fair 38% vs book 36%. Joint hit 9.7%, app payout 12.37x, EV +0.20 (still +0.05 after a 2-pt haircut on every leg).

Denver's offense is down to Dobbins/Coleman with Waddle limited, against KC's defense. MIA +2.5 at +183 is a stale rung: DK's own +3.5 is only +134, and storms favour the underdog. Edges: Denver Broncos team_totals Under 17.5 (+125) fair 46% vs book 44%; Miami Dolphins spreads +2.5 (+183) fair 38% vs book 35%. Joint hit 17.6%, app payout 6.37x, EV +0.12 (still +0.01 after a 2-pt haircut on every leg).

Dallas Turner has 6 sacks in 6 games. Dicker kicks for an offense with 9 FG and 9 TD drives that projects for about 18.5 points. Edges: Dallas Turner sacks Over 0.5 (+127) fair 47% vs book 44%; Cameron Dicker field_goals Over 1.5 (-102) fair 54% vs book 50%. Joint hit 24.9%, app payout 4.50x, EV +0.12 (still +0.03 after a 2-pt haircut on every leg).

McNeill has 3.5 sacks in 6 games, facing a Vikings line that allows sacks at 1.25x league rate. The model projects Dallas for about 30.7 points, but its score distribution gives the alt U27.5 a 40.7% chance vs 39.2% implied at +155, and the two legs are in different games. Edges: Alim McNeill sacks Over 0.5 (+221) fair 34% vs book 31%; Dallas Cowboys team_totals Under 27.5 (+155) fair 41% vs book 39%. Joint hit 14.0%, app payout 8.19x, EV +0.14 (still +0.02 after a 2-pt haircut on every leg).

Jaylen Warren has 100+ rushing yards in 3 of his last 5 games, and Pittsburgh is a home favourite against a below-average run defense. Cincinnati is a 12.5-point favourite, so the first half should be methodical: model 53.5% on U23.5 vs book 52.4%. Edges: Jaylen Warren rush_yds Over 69.5 (+112) fair 50% vs book 47%; Under totals_h1 Under 23.5 (-110) fair 53% vs book 52%. Joint hit 27.0%, app payout 4.05x, EV +0.09 (still +0.01 after a 2-pt haircut on every leg).

slates.label: Wednesday picks
slates.note: Week 8 Wednesday slate. These are player-prop edges from 2026 game logs (ESPN box scores and nflverse) blended with de-vigged DraftKings lines and alt ladders, with every leg in a different game within its parlay.

parlays.why: Sam Darnold Over 0.5 INT: has thrown one in all 5 games with real volume (8 INTs, ~4.6% rate); fair 60% vs 49% de-vigged. Jaylen Warren Over 22.5 rec yds: cleared it in 7 of 7 games (27-87); fair 60% vs 51%. Joe Burrow Over 5.5 rush yds: over in 5 of 6 games; fair 61% vs 51%.

Ollie Gordon II Under 10.5 rec yds: 14 receiving yards in 5 games (0, 14, 0, 0, 0 on 8 targets); model 74%, used 66% after a role-risk haircut (Jaylen Wright quad), vs 51% de-vigged book. Tee Higgins 80+ rec yds (+143): over 79.5 in 4 of 6 games, and Tennessee allows 246 rec yds/g (league 235); fair 48% vs 41% book.

Five independent games. Bryce Young Under 10.5 rush yds (6 of 6 under; 58% vs 50%), Bucky Irving Under 13.5 rec yds (6 of 7 under; 57% vs 49%), Keon Coleman Over 31.5 rec yds (4 of 6 over; 57% vs 50%), Ollie Gordon II Under 10.5 rec yds (66% vs 51%) and Tee Higgins Over 68.5 rec yds (56% vs 50%).
